preservation.baseline: 129 valid-domain cases compare original Laue output arrays, powder radii and deterministic event coordinates exactly. Added IDs do not change old event coordinates.

scientificMechanism.trackedObjects: Two true crystal-plane paths O and A–B–C, eight same-clock plane contributions, one selected reciprocal-lattice family, fixed sample identities, and the same foil/screen intersections.
scientificMechanism.causalBridge: AO and OC are equal-phase wavefronts normal to the actual incident/outgoing directions. Geometric AB+BC = 2d sin(theta) generates the phase, the summed field, and its constructive condition. The selected (2,1,-1) family also satisfies the retained full 3D elastic Laue equation.
scientificMechanism.predictions: Hold the 2000 V rings, test 5000 V against their fixed dashed reference; hold the fixed-band crystal, then rotate lattice and reciprocal vectors together. Fresh Explore preserves the current unrevealed question.
limits: No computed curve, Laue spot or deterministic electron point is labelled a historical measurement.
The original textbook aluminum-foil photograph is not fitted by the two example spacings.
Eight-plane kinematic scattering omits dynamical/multiple scattering and is not a nickel apparatus reconstruction.
Laue retains the original simple-cubic reciprocal-vector calculation; spot size and brightness are for identification.
The selected 2D family corresponds to (2,1,-1) at zero crystal rotation. Independent 2D angle changes illustrate phase and do not substitute for the full 3D Laue condition.
The 2D section uses an angle-dependent uniform display scale; printed values, not cross-frame pixel lengths, carry the pm scale.
Coincident Laue solutions are merged by the retained display calculation. A labelled wavelength belongs to the selected family and is not a measured spectrum.
